body:
This appears to be related to the "Lite" license submitted at #3004 

Given the restrictions on use, this certainly does not meet the "Other factor 1" (re: substantial compliance with open-source-like definitions) in the [SPDX License Inclusion Principles](https://github.com/spdx/license-list-XML/blob/main/DOCS/license-inclusion-principles.md).

I see no evidence of substantial use or indeed any use other than your own personal repo. Given that, it also would not meet "Other factor 3" under any reasonable reading.

I also note that the license URL linked above goes to a 404; and the license URL provided in #3004 points to https://thwinthithtoo15-beep.github.io/open-source-equal-license/#about, which lists a different version 1.1 of the license.

In light of all of that, this is not currently appropriate to add to the SPDX License List, so I am closing this and #3004 as not approved.
